senses.definition: To have information or a fact in your mind.

examples.text: Sé el número de teléfono de mi madre.
examples.translation: I know my mother's phone number.

senses.definition: To have the ability or skill to do something (followed by an infinitive).

examples.text: Ella sabe hablar español muy bien.
examples.translation: She knows how to speak Spanish very well.
